race.comment: COSMIC SHOWER (6) is overdue for a win and finds a nice set-up here. Ran on hard to finish a close-up fifth here last time and looks tough to hold out. BILK (5) tackled the same race as COSMIC SHOWER and pushed forward. Was there until the final stages before fading to third. Expected to give a sight again. GRAND MILLESIME (9) was fourth at Mildura two back then fifth at Bordertown latest. Nice weight drop with the claim and worth another chance. THE BLACK HARP (4) was in the market on debut at the provincials in the autumn and turned in an eye-catching run late after getting back and storming home. Given plenty of time and has good upside. GRECIAN JEWEL (12) also wasn't far away on debut and can only be improved.
